Alex: Quick sync — PM asked for per-tenant dashboards showing latency (p50/p95/p99), request throughput, cost estimate, cache hit rates, and noisy-neighbor detections. Need runtime/infra inputs on what signals we can reliably produce and cost impact. cc @Ravi @Kelsey
Ravi: We already emit per-request latency and KV cache hit events in traces, but we don't have a per-tenant KV cache size counter. We can add a counter at allocation points, downside: extra cardinality & ingest.
Kelsey: Clarify scope: is this for hosted customers or dedicated/private only? UI should support filtering by org and route.
Alex: Product wants per-org by default, but with privacy constraints. For hosted we may need to anonymize. Dedicated/private should get raw per-tenant views.
Sam: From runtime: we can tag metrics with tenant_id, model_variant, and route. For heavy metrics (kv_cache_size) we can approximate with a sampled aggregator instead of emitting every allocation.
Maria: Noisy neighbor detection idea: combine sudden p95 spikes + sustained token/sec increase + GPU mem pressure on nodes serving that tenant. We already have GPU mem and GPU util per host.
Kelsey: UX asks: timeframe selector, threshold alerts (per-tenant), CSV export, and a timeline of detected noisy events. Also a toggle for "show per-tenant metrics" (opt-in for hosted).
Ravi: Proposal for metrics ingestion contract: POST /metrics/ingest with labels: tenant_id, metric, value, unit, timestamp, source. Enforce cardinality caps and rate limits per tenant. Example payload:
```
{ "tenant_id": "org-123", "metric": "kv_cache_size_bytes", "value": 23456789, "timestamp": 1670000000 }
```
Sam: Implementation detail: emit at 1s granularity, roll up to 1m for p95. For suspected noisy neighbor detection we'll keep a short-term high-resolution buffer (30m) and a longer rollup for history.
Alex: Security/privacy: hosted customers should see hashed tenant ids or anonymized rollups unless they opt into detailed telemetry. Need to check legal for telemetry retention.
Kelsey: Product agrees: hosted = anonymized by default; dedicated/private = full per-tenant dashboards. We'll show a warning about increased cost.
Maria: For anomaly scoring we'll run rolling z-score on p95 per tenant and label events with an anomaly_score. Example: anomaly_score: 3.2 -> action: suggest throttling or routing change.
Sam: Runtime snippet for tagging (rough):
```
emit_metric('latency_ms', value, tags={ 'tenant_id': hash(org), 'route': route })
```
Alex: Ops question — can infra enforce a cardinality cap per org so bad instrumentation doesn't blow up billing?
Ravi: Yes. Plan: default cap 200 unique label combinations per tenant per minute, adjustable via contract. We'll add sampling fallback when exceeded.
ProductBot: @Kelsey owns the dash UX. Added to roadmap and created ticket PLAT-4721.
Kelsey: I'll mock 2 variants: compact KPI header (req/s, cost, p95) and expanded timeline with noisy event markers. Will include export and alert modal.
Sam: High-level implementation steps: 1) runtime tagging + flood guards; 2) metrics ingest API + schema + sampling; 3) rollup/aggregation jobs + anomaly detector; 4) dashboard front-end + RBAC and toggle. Rough ETA: 3 sprints if no major blockers.
Alex: Can infra provide a rough cost delta estimate for enabling high-res per-tenant metrics for hosted customers? We need to include in pricing doc.
Ravi: I'll compute delta based on estimated 1k tenants, avg 100 metrics/sec -> rough projection and put numbers in the ticket. We'll also propose a tiered retention plan.
Maria: For the noisy neighbor ML, I'll prototype a detector using p95 rolling window and GPU mem signals, outputting events like: {tenant_hash, start_ts, end_ts, anomaly_score, contributing_signals}.
Kelsey: Also need the Console to support RBAC so only allowed users can see tenant-level metrics. We'll reuse existing org-role checks.
Sam: Perf guard: if metric throughput > 5k/s across all tenants we'll switch to 1/N sampling and emit a sampling_rate tag.
Alex: Next steps: Ravi & Sam to draft the metrics schema and sampling policy; Kelsey to drop mockups and alert UX; Maria to propose detector algorithm & thresholds. Sync Friday 10am. :calendar:
Kelsey: Noted — I'll add Figma link in this thread when ready.
Ravi: I'll open a PR with a proto for the ingest API in eng-platform repo and ping reviewers.
Sam: I'll add runtime changes to the runtime backlog and run a perf test on a dev cluster.
Alex: Thanks all :thumbsup:
